prompt: 我想对比两个版本的 Agent——v1 用的是简单的 system prompt，v2 增加了 few-shot examples 和 tool use。需要一个科学的评估方法来判断 v2 是否真的比 v1 好，不能只靠感觉。

assertions.description: Provides a structured A/B comparison framework for two agent versions
Includes statistical significance testing (confidence intervals, p-values, or paired comparison)
Defines weighted scoring dimensions (not just pass/fail)
Defines clear pass/fail thresholds for deciding if v2 is better than v1
Runs each test case multiple times to account for LLM non-determinism
